# SqueezeNet-1.1 int8, normalisation folded into conv1, 33-class classifier
# Activations are int8 = uint8 - 128 (HW convention); after every ReLU the zero
# point is -128.  Network input = camera pixel - 128 (scale 1.0, zp 0), no
# preprocessing.  Weights: int8, symmetric per output channel (zp 0), one line
# per output channel, ordered [in_ch][ky][kx].  bias_hw already contains the
# input zero-point term:  acc = sum(w * x_hw) + bias_hw ;
# y_hw = clamp(z_out_hw + requant(acc, mult, shift), z_out_hw, 127)
# requant = tflite SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul(acc, mult) then rounding
# right shift by `shift` (shift<0 = left shift first), as rtl/tflite_requantizer.sv.
# Float scales are given too: real = scale * (q - zp).
